text_block_list.text:
As I was about to eat lunch,
I suddenly heard a loud voice nearby.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way~~!! No, no, no, no, NO!!
I'm never, ever eating vegetables!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... What a troublesome little witch.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You leave vegetables on your plate back at the dorm too,
so as dorm leader, I worry about your nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
Bell peppers and onions are a witch's natural enemies!
No matter what you say, I'm not gonna eat them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A 'witch's natural enemy', huh. —Ah, come to think of it,
a book I read once had this to say.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
'Witches are close friends not only with flowers and herbs,
but with all kinds of plants, including vegetables.'

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I would think a truly great witch would be on
wonderful terms with bell peppers and onions, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you take this chance to become friends, it might bring you
one step closer to being a great witch. Well, what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's... urgh...! But, but still~~~!

Eventually, Sweep Tosho, looking around for help,
locked eyes with me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Hey, you! Tell me what I should do!
choice_data_list: You really ought to eat your vegetables.
Just do whatever you want to do.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: N-No way~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's start with the bell pepper.
'Little witch, will you be my friend?'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine, I have no choice...!
To become a great witch... here goes...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *munch munch*............ *gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaahh! It's so biiitteeeer~~!
I knew I shouldn't have eaten it~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Besides, vegetables are nothing more than potion ingredients!
It's presumptuous to think they can be friends with a magical girl!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I hate this so much~~!!
Get rid of this gross bitterness already~!!
Waaaaaaaahhhhhhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Looks like the real challenge begins now.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll go get some juice right now.
So please, try to calm down... okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I see!
You make a pretty good point♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! I'm not eating any vegetables!
Instead of making friends, I'll subjugate them with magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So, these vegetables—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Go like this—and like that!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah... Hey, what are you doing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, what in the world is this...?! 
—V-Vegetables?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, case closed♪
See ya!

...Sweep Tosho dumped all the vegetables
from her plate onto Kawakami Princess's plate.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a seccooonnnnd!!
Hey, wait righhhht there!!
